thread:
elaine: Customer request - per-route cost + small dashboard. Can we scope a narrow MVP this sprint?

sam: Yes. MVP idea: three cards (p99 latency by route, avg token-cost per request, error rate by route). Minimal tags: route, model_family, cache_hit.

nico: Runtime change: add span attrs for route and cache_hit behind a flag. We'll avoid model checkpoint to limit cardinality.

anya: UI: compact tiles, tenant selector, time presets (1h/24h/7d). Add Export CSV on cost card. Mock by Wed.

ops-bot: Note: ingestion team needs schema change for "route" tag. Coordinate before enabling.

elaine: Proposed launch checklist: dashboards (hosted + dedicated), span attrs emitted, weekly CSV export to customer S3, 5% canary for 48h, perf bench <=5% overhead.

sam: Implementation split: runtime tagging (1 sprint), ingestion update (1 sprint), UI + export (1 sprint). Parallelize where possible.

nico: I'll own flag + canary runbook. Rollback if p99 > 1.2x or error rate doubles.

elaine: Risks: metric cardinality, runtime perf, export delivery for on-prem. Mitigations: restrict tags, canary, enterprise-only export transports.

anya: Will attach mocks by Wed (1767001800).

elaine: OK—team agreed on narrow MVP. Follow-up sync Thursday to create tickets and lock acceptance. :thumbsup:
